taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: shrub, 2-6 m. high, with slender often scandent branches.

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: shrub, 2-6 m. high.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: a shrub.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: a shrub with smooth, greenish, 4-angled branchlets.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: leaves thin and glabrous, deciduous.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Leaves in opposite pairs, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 170669920, 33656920, 221857237, 301748744, 12759210, 292980, 292989, 217060798): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: leaves 4-10 cm. long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves 2 cm to 5 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: petioles 5-15 mm. long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: leaves ovate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: acuminate at the apex.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: serrulate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: peduncles slender, 1-5-flowered: small cymes.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flowers on long stalks from the leaf axils, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 170669920, 33656920, 221857237, 301748744, 12759210, 292980, 292989, 217060798): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: peduncles 1-5-flowered.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: each cyme 1 cm to 2.5 cm across above its peduncle, as in the photos.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: peduncles slender, 25-60 mm. long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: flowers 8 mm to 10 mm across, their rounded petals 3 mm to 4 mm long (Abrams 1951 p. 53).

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: petals 5, rounded, 3-4 mm. long.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: petals 5.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: petals brownish purple, penciled; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: capsule deeply 3-lobed, depressed, smooth.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: capsules 1 cm to 1.5 cm across.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: capsules red when ripe, opening on seeds with a red aril (Abrams 1951 p. 53, key to genera).

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: flowering April and May.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Euonymus occidentalis: capsule deeply 3-lobed; a lobe to each cell, so it opens in 3 valves, as the photographs (imagekit batch c3-gaps-2026-10-19, observation of an open capsule) show them bent back.

traits.fruit_seed_colour.note: Abrams (1951 p. 53, key to genera): seeds with a red aril. The deep red is our reading of the aril-covered seed hanging from an open capsule in the photographs (imagekit batch c3-gaps-2026-10-19).

traits.fruit_seed_length_m.note: No flora read measures the seed. By eye against the capsule (1-1.5 cm) in the photographs (imagekit batch c3-gaps-2026-10-19): the aril-covered seed about half the capsule's length, 5-8 mm.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: capsules ripe August to October.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: an open shrub of slender, arching green branchlets and thin, toothed leaves in pairs, the purplish-brown flowers hanging on long threadlike stalks below them.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for western burning bush from its sources and the photos the traits cite; the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 3.2 m tall at 12 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
